Coram: Hon'Ble The Chief Justice
 Order

01. This application seeks transfer of the criminal complaint pending before the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ramban under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 to the court of competent jurisdiction at Rajouri.
02. While issuing notice on 16th May 2016, this Court had granted stay of further proceedings before the trial court.
03. Objections stand filed by the respondents.

04. There has been no appearance on behalf of the petitioner on 12.02.2019, 19.03.2019 and 23.04.2019.
05.
None appears on behalf of the petitioner when the matter is called out today.

06. Issue court notice without process fee to counsel for both the sides.
07.
